notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
As you might have noticed, a couple of updates have been uploaded this week. Here's a recap.

Update #3

- Game Over and Load game now reset extra lives and ammo. There was a bug introduced in 1.1 that caused the Game Over to not reset lives.
- Disabled boss key (ESC)

Update #2

- Fixed collected item count. Some unique items were not counted in

Update #1

- Fixed a bug that affected X-boss achievements
